changes: Full pre-deploy sweep found one genuinely serious issue: the new Casino Pot fine paths had no Firebase security rule at all, meaning the Ledger's Group Multi fine writes would have been silently rejected — the whole feature would have done nothing once deployed, with no visible error. Fixed.

Checked and confirmed clean across every file: all shared constants (split ratio, burn rate, both fine amounts, period-key logic) still match exactly everywhere, no duplicate IDs, no orphaned references from the Fines refactor.
Optimized the tipping-fines function's idempotency check from one Firebase read per pick to one read for the whole run — same safety guarantee, far fewer round trips on any backlog.
Widened the profile tabs' touch target for better mobile tap accuracy. Slots' "can't collect" bug remains open — ruled out one more theory, still needs live diagnostic data to actually resolve.
